entries.name: ubershader_archive_bin.metallib
entries.role: Core Image filter kernels (colour, blur, composite, generators, distortion)
entries.note: BifrOSt implements the Core Image filter categories as CPU pixel code with the reference parameters; no GPU filter kernels and no CIKernel language, so large images are slower. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: the Core Image filter family this library ships is implemented as CPU pixel code in springboard/render (filter.rs convolution, morphology, arithmetic and histogram; colorfx.rs colour filters; composite_filters.rs blend modes; blur_filters.rs blurs; colorcube.rs LUT colour cubes), each with tests. The GPU kernel itself is not reproduced; large images run slower.

entries.name: VertexShaders.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Vertex transform, skinning, blend shapes, smooth normals and tangent frames now exist on the CPU in kernel_mesh_vertex.rs with a GLSL skinning twin; raster3d.rs draws the triangles. No GPU 3D pipeline dispatches the shader yet, and dual-quaternion skinning is not built. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: vertex-stage kernels in springboard/render/src/kernel_mesh_vertex.rs (4x4 matrix algebra, Vulkan-style perspective, projection to screen, normal matrix, linear-blend skinning of positions and normals, morph-target accumulation, smooth vertex normals, tangent frame from UVs), tests kernel_mesh_vertex::tests; GLSL twin of skinning and morph in springboard/gpu/shaders/skin_blend.comp (not wired to a pipeline). The triangle rasteriser stays in bifrost-ui raster3d.rs. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: VECommonMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Video enhancement (deghosting, virtual shutter angle, common video-effect kernels)
entries.note: Encoder-side analysis, deinterlace, temporal denoise, flow warp and pyramid kernels now exist on the CPU in kernel_video_filters.rs, next to block_motion.rs, frame_interp.rs and the shutter blend and deghost in temporal_upscale.rs. There is no GPU video pipeline yet. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: video-processing kernels in springboard/render/src/kernel_video_filters.rs (SAD, 4x4 Hadamard SATD, 2x luma downscale, histogram scene-cut score, edge-directed deinterlace, motion-adaptive temporal denoise, flow warp, Gaussian pyramid step), tests kernel_video_filters::tests. Motion search is block_motion.rs, interpolation frame_interp.rs, shutter blend and median deghost temporal_upscale.rs; no GLSL file was written. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: videoDeghostingMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Video enhancement (deghosting, virtual shutter angle, common video-effect kernels)
entries.note: Frame interpolation and temporal accumulation run on CPU rasters; there is no deghosting or shutter-angle filter. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Shader pass: temporal deghosting: median_deghost (springboard/render/src/temporal_upscale.rs) keeps the static background and drops moving ghosts; CPU only.

entries.name: videoSuperResolutionMetalLib.metallib
entries.note: A deterministic spatial super-resolution path (edge-directed 2x plus contrast-adaptive sharpen, kernel_super_res.rs) now sits beside the bicubic and Lanczos scalers. A learned model is still absent: it needs trained weights that BifrOSt does not have. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready (classical path): edge-directed 2x upscale and contrast-adaptive sharpen in springboard/render/src/kernel_super_res.rs, tests kernel_super_res::tests; bicubic and Lanczos stay in upscale.rs and lanczos.rs. Learned super resolution needs trained weights, which BifrOSt does not ship, so no learned model is included; no GLSL file was written. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: virtualShutterAngleMetalLib.metallib
entries.role: Video enhancement (deghosting, virtual shutter angle, common video-effect kernels)
entries.note: A temporal accumulation model exists on CPU rasters. Built: shutter_blend averages the sub-frames inside a shutter of N degrees (temporal_upscale::tests). Gap: no virtual shutter kernel runs on the GPU, and the shader's own filter is not reproduced. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Shader pass: virtual shutter: shutter_blend averages the sub-frames inside the shutter angle on the CPU (springboard/render/src/temporal_upscale.rs); no GPU kernel.

entries.note: BifrOSt has no XR compositor, immersive display or spatial media pipeline, so this spatial shader has no component to serve.
